tracking: ADR-0327 (lane E12): the brief is API and backend only; the suggestions page (rule, evidence, savings, dismiss) is for UI-D

gaps.GET /v1/rule-steps/settings: reads the rule-like AI step detection switch and thresholds, with the strict defaults and floors
gaps.PUT /v1/rule-steps/settings: turns rule-like step detection on or off or changes its thresholds (enabling or lowering one is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/rule-steps/scan: scans recent model spans for AI steps that behave like fixed rules and stores suggestions (read-only, spaced 10 minutes, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/rule-steps/suggestions: lists rule-like step suggestions with the readable rule, test cases from history and projected monthly savings
gaps.GET /v1/rule-steps/suggestions/export.xl: exports the rule-like step suggestions list (summary columns only, never the rule cells) under the ADR-0226 list contract, audited
gaps.POST /v1/rule-steps/suggestions/:id/shad: puts a rule-like step suggestion in shadow mode: its rule is measured against live model spans by later scans (the AI still answers), audited
stops a rule-like step suggestion's shadow period and keeps its counts, audited
